sentences.text:
Court No. - 82
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 2310 of 2024
Applicant :- Kartikey Gupta

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar Singh,Saurabh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Session Trial No.2369 of 2022 (State Vs. Kartikey Gupta and others) arising
out of Case Crime No.287 of 2020 under Sections 420, 188, 269, 270 Ipc, Sections 15(2), 15(3) of
the Indian Medical Council Act,1956, Section 51 Disaster Management Act, 2005 and Section 3
Epidemic Disease Act, 1897, Police Station Mohammadabad, District Farrukhabad pending in the
Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Farrukhabad expeditiously within a stipulated period.
3.  It is submitted that the applicant is an accused in this case.
Cognizance was taken in the matter on 8.6.2022 and after framing of charge the matter was fixed for evidence.
Matter is pending since 2022 but only dates are being fixed.
The opposite party no.2 is trying to linger on the matter by filing adjournment applications.

sentences.text:
From the perusal of the order-sheet, it appears that during trial the dates were fixed either for the evidence or for the appearance of the parties but no evidence was adduced so far.
5.

In the circumstances, the trial court is directed to make all possible endeavours to conclude the trial of the case within one year from the date of receiving of the certified copy of the order of this Court without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.

6. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.

7. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 10.1.2025 ss  Kartikey Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025
